text:
hana: Short notes from design review on the mini quickstart pill (staging). Focus: motion, discoverability, and accessibility.

leo: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/staging/mini-quickstart-pill (frames: pill-pulse, expanded-panel, sample-grid).

rachel: UX problem: the pulsing animation increases discoverability but might annoy persistent users. Suggest pulse for 8s on first visit only, then a subtle static glow for 14 days. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

vik: Good call. For reduced motion we should skip pulse entirely and show a thin outline. Also keyboard users should see a visible focus ring with same accent color.

hana: Copy test: pill label options: "Quickstart" vs "Get started" vs "Samples". Which is clearest? I prefer "Quickstart" for brevity and clarity.

leo: Microcopy on expanded panel: change primary CTA from "Start sample" to "Launch sample"  feels more action-oriented. Add 1-line summary under each card and a small tag ("example", "template").

rachel: Accessibility nit: panel should announce "Quickstart opened" with aria-live=polite and set aria-expanded on the pill button. Also make sure aria-describedby references the one-line summary.

vik: Behavior: if user dismisses with "X" persist dismiss server-side and surface a small "Quickstart" icon in the header to reopen. If they click "Skip" explicitly, set onboarding.quickstart_skipped=true.

hana: Metrics: onboarding.pill.impression, onboarding.pill.pulse_shown, onboarding.panel.opened, onboarding.sample.launched. Add property { variant: pill_pulse|pill_static|no_pill }. A/B run for 3 weeks.

leo: Dev plan: gate behind flag mini_quickstart_v1 to 10% beta orgs. We'll stub telemetry behind the flag until validated. Also add experiment cookie to avoid re-pulsing users.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: mini-quickstart-pill @ commit f9ab2c  preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/quickstart.

rachel: Decision summary: use label "Quickstart", pulse only on first visit (8s), respect prefers-reduced-motion, persist dismiss server-side with header reopen icon, change CTA to "Launch sample", add aria-live announcements and aria-expanded, track proposed events, gate behind feature flag. Assign hana (copy + experiment) and vik (a11y + impl). Thanks!
